The '''NovaKite 35-E Porto''' was a highly mobile portable [[speeder bike]] manufactured by [[Ikas-Adno]] for civilian use.<ref name="DRVG" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|112}}</ref> [[Axis network]] leader [[Luthen Rael]] used a 35-E as his personal [[speeder]], carried on board his [[Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft|highly modified]] [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|V-21.1 Chevlex]] [[light haulcraft]].<ref name="DRVG" />
